title: Marlowe & Finch Unlimited Benefit — Addition to the Price-Protection Limit on Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Reservations
content:
A Marlowe & Finch Unlimited plan, held together with a Marlowe Rewards membership of Gold tier or above, adds to the price-protection limit on the customer's Pre-Orders & Back-Orders reservations.

| Marlowe & Finch Unlimited plan | Marlowe Rewards membership | Added to the protection limit |
|---|---|---|
| Active annual plan: Unlimited Standard Annual, Unlimited Express Annual, Unlimited Next-Day Annual or Unlimited Student Annual | Active Gold, Platinum, Icon or Atelier | 2 percentage points (0.02) |
| Active monthly plan: Unlimited Standard Monthly or Unlimited Express Monthly | Active Gold, Platinum, Icon or Atelier | 1 percentage point (0.01) |
| Any other customer, including an Unlimited member below Gold | — | Nothing (0.0) |

**Records read.** The plan and its status on the customer's Marlowe & Finch Unlimited membership, and the tier and status of the customer's Marlowe Rewards membership. Both must be active, and the tier must be Gold or above.

**Combinations (hypothetical customers)**

| Unlimited | Marlowe Rewards | Added |
|---|---|---|
| Unlimited Next-Day Annual, active | Gold, active | 2 points |
| Unlimited Express Monthly, active | Atelier, active | 1 point |
| Unlimited Standard Annual, active | Silver, active | Nothing |
| Unlimited Student Annual, not active | Platinum, active | Nothing |
| None | Icon, active | Nothing |

The addition is a share of the reserved unit price. For example, 2 points added to a protection limit of 10 percent make it 12 percent.
